574-2169-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-2169-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.
574-2169-4694-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

676-1170-8164.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1170-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4365-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

751-2653-3314-5621.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying one mana.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5256-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6149.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6149.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Stirring Bard from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Stirring Bard enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Stirring Bard.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Stirring Bard token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Stirring Bard token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Stirring Bard that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Stirring Bard trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6149.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

232-1418-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice due to Vantress Visions.
Resolve both innate Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for the remaining offspring trigger.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice.
Resolve both innate Appa triggers, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending nothing.
Resolve the second offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending the nontoken Appa.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
232-1418-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

3177-3259-5233--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3177-3259-5233--85--106.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

814-3259-7292.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
814-3259-7292.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Myrel as attackers.
Myrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-7060.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

225-575-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
225-575-5971-7097.description:
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {2} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Zimone trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Yavimaya Elder.
Activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger from step 5, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4875-5310-6797-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4875-5310-6797-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

2034-2919-3330-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3330-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

147-2562-5147.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Graceful Reprieve, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Graceful Reprieve.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control that does not have summoning sickness

515-1636-1876.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Nissa, Worldwaker.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

147-413-3890.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
147-413-3890.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Unearth.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1486-1651-2750.description:
Cause Magda to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat from step 2.

4131-4222-4758-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

2178-5147-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-5147-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1129-5137-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Allies.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1129-5137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1978-3941-5793.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat

2882-3624-4050-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to any creature you control that does not have a cycling ability.
2882-3624-4050-4999.description:
Cast Flourishing Fox either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of the creature with Infinite Reflection attached.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flourishing Fox, adding {W}.
If you cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard, Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.

2034-2883-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Twisted Sewer-Witch, adding {C}{C}.
When Twisted Sewer-Witch dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Twisted Sewer-Witch from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Twisted Sewer-Witch enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token, and then creating a Wicked Role Aura token attached to each Rat you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
The Wicked Role token triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

262-3812-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Simic Ragworm.
Simic Ragworm does not have summoning sickness.
262-3812-4289.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1283-2107-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sunastian Falconer.
Sunastian Falconer does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2107-4222.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Sunastian Falconer.
Repeat.

505-1558-1692-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Izoni.
You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
505-1558-1692-3263.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Izoni with haste.
The Izoni token enters the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Insect creature tokens equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

92-2927-3392.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total among all players.
92-2927-3392.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Cast Plunge into Darkness by paying {1}{B}, choosing to pay an amount of life equal to the greatest lifetotal among opponent, then look at that many cards from the top of your library, putting one into your hand and exiling the rest.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
